title: Chimney caps.
officialText:
Termination caps shall not be permitted and a 3-inch (76 mm) minimum drain shall be installed to
receive collected water. A positive means shall be provided to prevent water from entering the appliance.
Exception: Termination caps shall be permitted on listed factory-built chimneys.
